en: Colorized vintage postcard view of a river with a small wooden ferry or boat in the foreground carrying several people. Across the river stands a large industrial complex with tall brick buildings and multiple smokestacks, set against a backdrop of green hills and scattered town buildings. The sky is blue with scattered clouds. Red printed text in German at the top left reads "Rosawitz b. Bodenbach".
